programme.title: Venezuela, Vignettes of the Orenoco Mission
programme.desc: The Orinoco is one of the most important rivers in South America. It originates in Venezuela and mainly crosses this country with the third largest water flow in the world before reaching the Atlantic in the state of Delta Amacuro. This state is the second least populated in Venezuela, which is easy to understand since most of its more than 40,000 square kilometers is just water and forest. Capuchin missionaries arrived in the early 20th century and established the first missionary center, Mission de Caroní, in Araguaimujo, in 1925. Many of those who reached first died of malaria and yellow fever. Of the missionaries who arrived in the 1950s, few are still alive; however, new missionaries have arrived and others continue to arrive to support the work of evangelism.

programme.title: 13 Razones para amar la vida
programme.desc: No hay amor más grande que el que da la vida por los amigos. Jesús es el amigo por excelencia. Los amigos son benevolentes. Tu amigo te escucha, te regala su tiempo. Cada amigo es la presencia de Cristo. Cuida la amistad. Otra razón para amar al vida.

programme.title: Vaticano
programme.desc: Esta semana en Vaticano, exploramos el camino cristiano hacia la eternidad. Desde las antiguas catacumbas de Roma, donde los primeros cristianos sepultaban a sus difuntos y proclamaban su esperanza en la vida después de la muerte, hasta el Dicasterio de las Causas de los Santos, donde la Iglesia sigue presentando a hombres y mujeres de virtudes heroicas como modelos de santidad, descubrimos qué significa vivir con el cielo como destino último. También conversamos con un capellán de hospital sobre el sacramento de la Unción de los Enfermos y visitamos el Museo de las Almas del Purgatorio para profundizar en la enseñanza de la Iglesia sobre el purgatorio y en la esperanza que une a vivos y difuntos.

Desde las antiguas catacumbas de Roma, donde los primeros cristianos sepultaban a sus difuntos y proclamaban su esperanza en la vida después de la muerte, hasta el Dicasterio de las Causas de los Santos, donde la Iglesia sigue presentando a hombres y mujeres de virtudes heroicas como modelos de santidad, descubrimos qué significa vivir con el cielo como destino último. También conversamos con un capellán de hospital sobre el sacramento de la Unción de los Enfermos y visitamos el Museo de las Almas del Purgatorio para profundizar en la enseñanza de la Iglesia sobre el purgatorio y en la esperanza que une a vivos y difuntos.

programme.title: Cocina franciscana
programme.desc: Hoy toca receta dulce. Los "donuts" son un bollo muy esponjoso en forma de rosquilla, también se les llaman donas.

programme.title: Canta y no llores
programme.desc: Serie de programas de una hora de duración, grabados en España, con la participación de cantautores y grupos de lo más destacado del panorama de la música religiosa. Presentado por el cantautor hispano - Uruguayo: Luis Alfredo Díaz. Canta y no llores, es un encuentro en profundidad con la música y la espiritualidad.

programme.title: Tertulias de fe
programme.desc: El Padre Gerardo Mendoza es un sacerdote de la Diócesis de San Bernardino que fue ordenado en julio de 1988 y cuenta con casi cuatro décadas de trayectoria pastoral en el sur de California. A lo largo de su ministerio, ha servido como párroco en iglesias de ciudades como Norco e Indio, donde la comunidad hispana lo reconoce por su calidez y su guía espiritual. Además de su labor en las parroquias, ayudó a fundar en 2011 el capítulo en español del movimiento católico Magnificat con la aprobación del obispo de la región.

programme.title: Siervo de todos
programme.desc: En un tiempo en el que la voz del Señor parece ahogada por «otras voces» y la propuesta de seguirlo entregando la propia vida puede parecer un absurdo, Dios sigue llamando a quien quiere, otorgando a través del Sacramento del Orden, la misión de servir en nombre y representación de Cristo-Cabeza en medio de la comunidad. A toda la Iglesia le urge responder a esta llamada.

programme.title: Mientras el mundo gira
programme.desc: Los modales son buenas costumbres y cortesía, son las acciones, posturas y comportamientos externos con los que una persona demuestra respeto, educación y refinamiento hacia los demás. El saludar al llegar, dar las gracias, pedir permiso o escuchar sin interrumpir, son ejemplos básicos. El Padre Willie nos advierte que la falta de ellos causa desaprobación social. Los modales son como una caricia, no han pasado de moda, solo que están escasos.

programme.title: Conozca primero su fe católica
programme.sub-title: Ante la superstición: ¡Sólo Jesús tiene poder!
programme.desc: El Padre Pedro nos explica que la superstición nos lleva a poner nuestra confianza en cosas o personas que, en sí, no tienen poder alguno. La superstición es, por lo tanto, una desviación de la fe en el Único que tiene poder para darnos vida nueva y vida abundante, y ese es Jesucristo. Además responde a las preguntas llegadas al programa vía telefónica, el correo electrónico (padrepedro@ewtn.com) y Facebook (www.facebook.com/ppedronunez).

programme.title: Perspectiva Católica
programme.desc: En una época en la que la bandera de la libertad parece flamear casi en todas partes, se dan cada vez más y más atropellos en contra de la libertad de vivencia y profesión de la fe. Magdalena Lira, directora nacional de ACN (Ayuda a la Iglesia que sufre) en Chile, nos ofrece un panorama de la situación en el país, que se encuentra en observación en materia de libertad religiosa.

programme.title: Informe provida
programme.sub-title: Cuando la desesperación tiene una salida
programme.desc: En este programa nos uniremos en oración por la defensa de la vida, inspirados en el legado del Beato Fulton J. Sheen y su profunda devoción a la Hora Santa. A través de la adoración eucarística y la oración por los niños por nacer, reflexionaremos sobre la importancia de interceder por quienes se encuentran en peligro de aborto, confiando en el poder de la oración y en la misericordia de Dios.

programme.title: De dos en dos
programme.sub-title: San Ignacio y los ejercicios espirituales
programme.desc: De soldado herido a fundador de una orden religiosa que cambió el mundo. Descubre cómo la transformación espiritual de San Ignacio de Loyola dio origen a los Ejercicios Espirituales, una guía profunda para encontrar a Dios en todas las cosas.

programme.title: Ángelus con el Papa León XIV
programme.desc: El Papa León XIV reza el Ángelus desde Roma. Esta oración especial, acompañada del toque de la campana del Ángelus, conmemora la Encarnación de Cristo.

programme.title: Hector Valdivielso: el primer santo argentino
programme.desc: Este documental cuenta la historia del primer santo argentino Héctor Valdivielso Sáez quien hizo parte de los ocho católicos mártires de la llamada Revolución de Asturias. El y sus compañeros fueron fusilados sin acusación ni juicio previo.

programme.title: Vaticano
programme.desc: Esta semana en Vaticano, exploramos el camino cristiano hacia la eternidad. Desde las antiguas catacumbas de Roma, donde los primeros cristianos sepultaban a sus difuntos y proclamaban su esperanza en la vida después de la muerte, hasta el Dicasterio de las Causas de los Santos, donde la Iglesia sigue presentando a hombres y mujeres de virtudes heroicas como modelos de santidad, descubrimos qué significa vivir con el cielo como destino último. También conversamos con un capellán de hospital sobre el sacramento de la Unción de los Enfermos y visitamos el Museo de las Almas del Purgatorio para profundizar en la enseñanza de la Iglesia sobre el purgatorio y en la esperanza que une a vivos y difuntos.

programme.title: Tertulias de fe
programme.desc: El Padre Gerardo Mendoza es un sacerdote de la Diócesis de San Bernardino que fue ordenado en julio de 1988 y cuenta con casi cuatro décadas de trayectoria pastoral en el sur de California. A lo largo de su ministerio, ha servido como párroco en iglesias de ciudades como Norco e Indio, donde la comunidad hispana lo reconoce por su calidez y su guía espiritual. Además de su labor en las parroquias, ayudó a fundar en 2011 el capítulo en español del movimiento católico Magnificat con la aprobación del obispo de la región.

programme.title: Mientras el mundo gira
programme.desc: Los modales son buenas costumbres y cortesía, son las acciones, posturas y comportamientos externos con los que una persona demuestra respeto, educación y refinamiento hacia los demás. El saludar al llegar, dar las gracias, pedir permiso o escuchar sin interrumpir, son ejemplos básicos. El Padre Willie nos advierte que la falta de ellos causa desaprobación social. Los modales son como una caricia, no han pasado de moda, solo que están escasos.

programme.title: Conozca primero su fe católica
programme.sub-title: Ante la superstición: ¡Sólo Jesús tiene poder!
programme.desc: El Padre Pedro nos explica que la superstición nos lleva a poner nuestra confianza en cosas o personas que, en sí, no tienen poder alguno. La superstición es, por lo tanto, una desviación de la fe en el Único que tiene poder para darnos vida nueva y vida abundante, y ese es Jesucristo. Además responde a las preguntas llegadas al programa vía telefónica, el correo electrónico (padrepedro@ewtn.com) y Facebook (www.facebook.com/ppedronunez).

programme.desc: Dave Stotts takes an adventure and steps between the pages of the Old Testament, back in time, before the existence of Israel, to walk alongside the Patriarchs.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - Holy Land
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Temple, Cross, and the Empty Tomb - Part 3
programme.desc: Dave Stotts takes an adventure and steps between the pages of the Old Testament, back in time, before the existence of Israel, to walk alongside the Patriarchs.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.desc: Dave Stotts open in Jerusalem and discuss the impact of Jesus over the last 2,000 years. He presents the set-up for the arrival of Jesus in the context of Jewish and Roman history. He travel to Nazareth and present the four different Gospel writers, Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John and learns the importance of genealogies as they related to a promised Jewish Messiah.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Miracle of the Annunciation
programme.desc: Dave Stotts stays in Nazareth and investigates the Annunciation, where the Angel Gabriel delivered very special news to a virgin girl named Mary. He explore the concepts of angels, miracles, and the importance of the Virgin Birth. He discusses the Roman census and the trip by Joseph and Mary to Bethlehem and examines the importance of Bethlehem in the ancient prophecies about a coming Messiah.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.desc: Dave Stotts visit the Church of the Nativity in Bethlehem and takes a look at the accounts of Jesus’ birth. He examines the birthplace of Jesus and the accounts of shepherds in the fields nearby. He explores the journey of the "Wise Men" from the East, known as Magi, and the Star of Bethlehem that summoned them. Dave Stotts then investigates the date for Jesus’ birth and the importance of Christmas traditions throughout the centuries.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Jesus Grows Up During the Reign of King Herod
programme.desc: Dave Stotts delve into the world of Herod the Great at the time of Jesus’ birth. He examines the “slaughter of the innocents” in Judea. He then visits a number of awesome archaeological sites in Israel built by Herod, including the massive Herodium about seven miles south of Jerusalem. He learn about the escape of Joseph, Mary and Jesus to Egypt until Herod’s death and travels to Jesus’ hometown of Nazareth where he later grew up.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: John the Baptist and the Start of Jesus' Ministry
programme.desc: Dave Stotts starts with the world of Jesus’ youth after the death of Herod the Great. He delves into the Roman occupation and its impact on the Jewish people and learns about John the Baptizer and his ministry of repentance in the wilderness. We experience the baptism of Jesus at the Jordan River and his testing in the Judean desert shortly thereafter.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Jesus Returns to Galilee
programme.desc: Dave Stotts explores the Sea of Galilee where Jesus begins his active ministry and gathers his first disciples Peter, Andrew, James and John.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Jesus Turns Water to Wine and Confronts Legalism
programme.desc: Dave Stott visit Chorazin, another location in Jesus’ ministry. He examine Cana and the first miracle performed by Jesus at the wedding in Cana, Jesus turns water to wine, astounding the guests. He follow Jesus to Jerusalem, where Jesus occasionally travelled during special Jewish festivals. He gets angry at the treatment of the temple in Jerusalem and he confronts the religious elites. Jesus meets a Pharisee named Nicodemus and delivers a very special message about eternal life.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Jesus Teachings Change Lives
programme.desc: Dave Stotts travel to Samaria and learn about the history of the Samaritans. He learns the story of the Samaritan woman at the well. He again travel to Jerusalem and investigate two pools where Jesus performed special miracles and learns that Jesus brings Living Water. We hear Jesus proclaim himself as the Light of the World.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Sermon on the Mount
programme.desc: Dave Stotts visit the hillsides of Galilee and hear Jesus deliver the Sermon on the Mount. He walk the Mount of the Beatitudes and explore many of Jesus’ radically new teachings. He learn about salted fish at Magdala and Roman roads at Hippos and delves into Jesus' use of parables, including many of the most famous delivered by Jesus during his ministry.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Jesus Travels the Sea of Galilee
programme.desc: Jesus chose twelve apostles from his group of followers. Spend time on the Sea of Galilee and see Jesus calm the waves as he traveled the ancient harbors.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.desc: Travel to Caesarea Philippi where Jesus started to wrap-up his public ministry. Also, witness a mountaintop miracle known as the Transfiguration.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Extraordinary Life of Jesus of Nazareth
programme.desc: On his way to Jerusalem, Jesus spent time with children and confronted a rich young ruler. Visit Bethany and experience the raising of Lazarus from the dead.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Jesus Arrives in Jerusalem
programme.desc: Jesus visited Jericho on his final approach to Jerusalem. Experience the accounts of Bartimaeus, the blind beggar, and Zacchaeus, the tax collector.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.desc: Jesus and his disciples leave the temple complex and discuss the destruction of the temple. Jesus predicts the terrible events that will take place, including his own betrayal and crucifixion.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Trial of Jesus
programme.desc: See the the events that led up to the trial of Jesus. He prayed in the Garden of Gethsemane, He was betrayed by Judas and arrested by the Jewish authorities.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Crucifixion Of Jesus
programme.desc: Experience the horrible torture of Jesus and his agonizing execution just outside the walls of Jerusalem and examine the nature of crucifixion and the importance of Jesus’ death.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Resurrection of Jesus
programme.desc: Share in the excitement of an empty tomb three days after Jesus’ death, visiting Jerusalem to investigate the accounts of the Resurrection. Explore the Jewish and Roman responses to such a miraculous event.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - The Gospels
programme.desc: We finish with the four faces of the Gospels, the different biographical perspectives on the life of Jesus. We reexamine the Messianic prophecies and visit Qumran in the context of the Dead Sea Scrolls. What is the legacy of Jesus’ followers? What is the summary of the “Good News” of the Gospel accounts? Dave gets personal and ties it all together.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - Acts to Revelation
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Gospel Shared at Pentecost
programme.desc: In this series, Dave investigates the period of time following Jesus’s resurrection and looks at the courageous lives of the very first Christians.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - Acts to Revelation
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Church Grows in Jerusalem
programme.desc: In this episode of "Drive Thru History," Dave Stotts helps us witness the growing tension in Jerusalem as the followers of Jesus, known as the Way, face opposition from the religious authorities.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - Acts to Revelation
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Gospel Spreads to the Gentiles
programme.desc: In the early days of the church, the followers of Jesus face intense persecution in Jerusalem. As they scatter to different regions, the gospel continues to spread. Philip, one of the disciples, goes to Samaria where he preaches and performs miracles, capturing the attention of the people.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - Acts to Revelation
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Saul of Tarsus and the Road to Damascus
programme.desc: Visit Paul's hometown of Tarsus in present-day Turkey and experience his supernatural encounter with Jesus, which sparked his transformation to Paul the Apostle.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - Acts to Revelation
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: Paul's First Missionary Journey: The Island of Cyprus
programme.desc: Dave Stotts explores the city of Antakya, the ancient Syrian Antioch, where the early followers of Jesus were first called Christians. He also visits the ancient cities of Salamis and Paphos in the island of Cyprus, where Paul, Barnabas, and John Mark preached the gospel and encountered opposition.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - Acts to Revelation
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The First Journey Continues: Pamphylia, Galatia and Asia Minor
programme.desc: Dave Stotts continues traveling the route of Paul's first missionary journey, sailing north from Cyprus to the coast of Asia Minor.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - Acts to Revelation
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Jerusalem Council and the Start of Paul's Second Missionary Journey
programme.desc: After a special meeting of church leaders in Jerusalem let by James, Paul and Silas were off on a second missionary journey.

programme.title: Drive Thru History - Acts to Revelation
programme.sub-title: Dave Stotts: The Second Journey Continues: Philippi and Thessalonica
programme.desc: Dave Stotts takes us on a road trip through present-day Greece, following the footsteps of Paul and his team as they travel from Neapolis to Philippi and then to Thessalonica.

programme.desc: This week on American Trends & Lifestyle, our new host Lauren Makk gets into the Halloween spirit with a look at Orlando’s seasonal fun and steps into the magical world of Willy Wonka. Plus, Trans-Siberian Orchestra celebrates 30 years of rocking the holidays, author Nathan Moris shares tips for meaningful life changes, and we go behind the scenes of the adventure thriller Heart of the Beast. We’ll also share important information to help those living with asthma better understand and manage their condition.

programme.title: Coffee with America Episode 639
programme.desc: This week on an all-new episode of Coffee with America, host Sasha Rionda celebrates fall with a coastal California getaway and smart strategies for navigating the season’s biggest sales. Plus, we share tips for protecting loved ones from online scams, managing fall allergens at home, and helping teen drivers stay safer behind the wheel. We’ll also travel to Costa Rica for a luxurious escape inspired by coffee traditions and head to Hong Kong for a colorful look at its Mid-Autumn Festival celebrations.

Plus, Trans-Siberian Orchestra celebrates 30 years of rocking the holidays, author Nathan Moris shares tips for meaningful life changes, and we go behind the scenes of the adventure thriller Heart of the Beast. We’ll also share important information to help those living with asthma better understand and manage their condition.

programme.title: Coffee with America Episode 639
programme.desc: This week on an all-new episode of Coffee with America, host Sasha Rionda celebrates fall with a coastal California getaway and smart strategies for navigating the season’s biggest sales. Plus, we share tips for protecting loved ones from online scams, managing fall allergens at home, and helping teen drivers stay safer behind the wheel. We’ll also travel to Costa Rica for a luxurious escape inspired by coffee traditions and head to Hong Kong for a colorful look at its Mid-Autumn Festival celebrations.

programme.title: American Trends & Lifestyle Episode 16
programme.desc: This week on American Trends & Lifestyle, Lauren Makk celebrates National Gumbo Day with a taste of Louisiana’s rich culinary traditions and shares simple ways to manage fall allergens at home. Plus, the show offers smart financial strategies for small business owners, nutritious ideas to make family mealtime easier, and healthy habits to support those taking GLP-1 medications. We also get into the Halloween spirit and hear an inspiring story of resilience, perseverance, and gratitude.

programme.title: Coffee with America Episode 641
programme.desc: This week on an all-new episode of Coffee with America, Sasha Rionda celebrates fall with seasonal finds, a taste of Louisiana’s gumbo traditions, and a culinary train adventure through Europe. Plus, the show shares important insights into menopause and women’s midlife health, explores smart technology to help keep cats healthy, and offers practical financial strategies and employee benefits advice to help small business owners finish the year strong.

programme.title: 2025 National Team Trials: Boulder Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The 2025 National Team Trials: Boulder Finals. The 2025 National Team Trials Presented by YETI kick off in Mesa Rim in Austin, TX! 117 registered athletes will compete for spots on the Boulder, Lead, and Speed National Teams, with the opportunity to represent the USA at international World Cups.

programme.title: First Female Ascent and Exploration in Cuba
programme.desc: Sasha and friends are in Cuba for some jungle sport climbing!

programme.title: Beckett Hsin Sends V17 at 16 Years Old
programme.desc: Last week, on February 24, 16-year-old Beckett Hsin became the youngest person in the world to send the hardest confirmed grade in bouldering when he topped out on No One Mourns the Wicked (V17) in Thunder Ridge, Colorado. Here, he discusses his "boulder his age" challenge that he started when he was just 12 years old.

programme.title: Are You a Dancer or a Fighter?
programme.desc: Climbing Coach Casey Elliot explains that there are two types of climbers: the try-hard, onsighting Fighters and the meticulous, projecting Dancers. Casey explains how he and his "Dancer" climbing friend came up with this revelation and gives the advice that pushing yourself to channel both styles of climbing will help you become a more balanced climber.

programme.title: Climbing Holds... Made Out of Mushrooms
programme.desc: Climbing Editor-in-Chief Maya Silver recounts speaking with Marta Agueda and Manuela Garcia, the founders of MAD, about their sustainable climbing holds made out of the roots of mushrooms in Berlin. As approximately 7 million plastic climbing holds end up in the landfill every year, these European game changers are forging a more sustainable path for the future of gyms. Read the full story here: https://www.climbing.com/culture-climbing/sustainable-climbing-holds-mushrooms-bioresins-recycled-plastic/

programme.title: Climbing's Newest Hotbed | No Days Off
programme.desc: Sasha travels to Manikia, a small village in Greece, to experience an emerging climbing destination. Manikia has only recently come into the spotlight as a potential world-class climbing destination. Sasha is joined on this adventure by fellow climbers from the Petzl team. The ultimate goal is to help establish a new climbing area the right way. During this trip, Sasha and the team set new routes in calibration with local climbers and guides while discussing ecotourism's positive and negative effects on local communities.

programme.title: How to Make a Solid Tape Glove
programme.desc: Professional climber and Climbing Contributor Genevive Walker demonstrates how to make a quality tape glove to use while crack climbing. She includes pro tips like the fact that tape gloves can be reused, if the tape is removed carefully!

programme.title: How to Climb in the Steeps
programme.desc: Climbing Contributor and professional climber Genevive Walker gives tips and tricks for climbing in the steeps, demonstrating proper foot placement, core engagement, and more.

programme.title: Episode 6 | Weekend Whipper | Ripping Cams in a Swedish Finger Crack
programme.desc: Climber Fay Manners takes a fall on "Trampoline"(5.11b) in Bohuslän, Sweden, in this week's Weekend Whipper, ripping out a cam in a finger crack.

programme.title: A Guide to Climber Skincare
programme.desc: Professional climber and Climbing contributor Genevive Walker does a show-and-tell with her favorite skincare products that are useful for climbers. She covers antihydral, Rhino Dry spray, Rhino Split+ (a hyaluronic acid cream), Rhino Spit (an aloe-based spray), Rhino Repair, and the importance of tape and of filing down calluses.

programme.title: How I Deal with the Fear of Falling in the Gym
programme.desc: Avianna Frady, Instagram-popular climber @climbwithavi, shares how she deals with the fear of falling in the gym. Falling can be intimidating, especially during dynos, but she makes herself practice falling so that she gets comfortable with it and can try big moves.

programme.title: The Blind Ascensionist
programme.desc: At 14, Justin Salas lost his vision but not his inner drive for adventure. This thrill seeker will take us on a journey of learning to navigate our world legally blind while pushing past any barrier or boulder in his way en route to becoming a World Champion Climber who continues to pursue a new challenge at every turn. Through Justin’s narration, viewers will be drawn into his mindset as he navigates through his physical, mental, and emotional barriers, only to find the strength to push past any “boulders” put in front of him. When Justin lost sight, climbing helped him build resilience and relationships as he found his place in the world as a blind young adult, and now he shows the world how he sees it.

programme.title: Climbing Switzerland’s Luzzone Dam
programme.desc: Two women climb the tallest artificial climbing route in the world, the Luzzone Dam. Standing at 541 feet tall, the dam is great for those experienced in multi-pitch routes, or can be top-roped by booking a guide. The climb is described as exposed and ridiculously fun with great views. Get the full guide to climbing the dam here: https://www.climbing.com/travel/climbing-luzzone-dam/

programme.title: Grim Ripper: The Scariest Gear Fails
programme.desc: In this Halloween-themed episode of Weekend Whipper, a bunch of climbers scream as they take giant falls, the result of various gear failures.

programme.title: YETI Climbing National Championships 2026 - Boulder Semi-Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The USA Climbing 2026 National Championships for Youth (YETI Nationals) at High Point Climbing and Fitness in Orlando, FL, bringing together top young climbers for Boulder, Lead, and Speed events to crown national champions and select athletes for national teams, showcasing Florida's competitive climbing scene.

programme.title: The Future of Fashion | No Days Off
programme.desc: Sasha meets up with professional Kiteboarder and swimwear designer Sensi Graves to hear what makes Sensi's business specializing in fashion. Sensi Graves is a self-made entrepreneur who started her sustainable swimwear brand - her materials are made from 100% recycled ocean plastics and reclaimed fishing nets. To round out this Oregon adventure and get the whole Hood River experience, Sasha and Sensi decide to trade sports for a day - Sasha tries kiteboarding for the first time, and Sensi tries her hand at climbing.

programme.title: Inside the Brazilian Climber Girl's Van-Meets-Gear-Closet
programme.desc: Professional climber and climbing guide Gisely Ferraz (@brazilianclimbergirl on her popular Instagram account) shows how she optimizes her camper van to store her climbing gear.

programme.title: Peak Exclusive Trailer
programme.desc: An exclusive clip of Peak, a cooperative climbing video game published by Aggro Crab and Landfall, is available on Steam. The game supports up to four players, and the goal is to get to the top of a mountain after crash landing on an island.

programme.title: Yoga for Climbers: Yoga to Prevent Injuries and Control Breathing CLIMB 25 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Whether you're a veteran big waller, casual gym climber, or just getting started, doing yoga will help you send. In this episode, pro climber and yoga instructor Heidi Wirtz will help prevent injuries and control your breathing.

programme.title: Training and Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Sasha DiGiulian returns to Boulder from Toronto. She works out at home and shows us a new green juice recipe.

programme.title: 2 Skills to Prevent Multi-pitch Accidents
programme.desc: Climbing contributor Nathan Conroy walks viewers through the SERENE method of building a trad anchor. He demonstrates how to rappel without a belay device using three locking carabiners and a prussik. Read the story: https://www.climbing.com/skills/multi-pitch-techniques-to-prevent-accidents-and-get-yourself-off-the-wall/

programme.title: Episode 11, Weekend Whipper: Slab Slide
programme.desc: This Weekend Whipper features a UGC clip of an slab free climbing fall, saved only by grabbing onto an anchor further down the route.

programme.title: Climbing in Boulder
programme.desc: Sasha DiGiulian spends the morning in Boulder working Thunder Muscle, a 5.14a nestled between the Flatirons. Then she races back to town, packs a bag and catches a flight to San Francisco for a photoshoot with her newest sponsor, Tiger Balm.

programme.title: Dear Mother
programme.desc: Climber and transracial Asian-American, Cody Kaemmerlen, searches for a connection with his birth parents after a near-death fall leaves him shaken and grasping for answers.

programme.title: Veronica Chik - 'Fish Eye' (8c)
programme.desc: Nine-year-old Chinese climber Veronica Chik sends 'Fish Eye' (5.14b; 8c) in Oliana Spain, becoming the world's youngest person to successfully climb the grade. Watch Chik send the route and talk about her love of the sport.

programme.title: 2025 National Team Trials: Boulder Semi-Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The 2025 National Team Trials: Boulder Semi-Finals. The 2025 National Team Trials Presented by YETI kick off in Mesa Rim in Austin, TX! 117 registered athletes will compete for spots on the Boulder, Lead, and Speed National Teams, with the opportunity to represent the USA at international World Cups.

programme.title: Episode 17, Weekend Whipper: Falling Climber Gets Saved at the Last Second
programme.desc: In this Weekend Whipper, climber Avery Lieu falls while climbing Scary Monsters (5.12a) in Joshua Tree National Park, hitting the rope on the way down.

programme.title: Red Flags: Bolts and Fixed Anchors
programme.desc: Chris Brown, Pro Anchor Maintenance Crew at Salt Lake Climbers Alliance, explains what he looks for when performing maintenance on bolts and fixed anchors. He uses a magnet to test the metal, and looks to see if there is rust, corrosion, bending, or if an anchor is loose. Stainless steel glue-in bolts are the new highest quality standard.

programme.title: The Sport Climbing Fall That Led to a Thumb Amputation
programme.desc: Sam Macllwaine, Associate Editor at Climbing Magazine and Jeff Jaramillo, Head of Outreach & Gear Education at WeighMyRack discuss a climbing accident and how to avoid injuries. Mylee Lorenz, a climber, fell while clipping, and got a rope wrapped around her thumb, resulting in an amputation. Jeff explains scenarios that could have cause this and what to do instead. He says to make sure there isn’t a twist in the rope, not to back clip, and not to grab for a rope when you fall.

programme.title: Episode 18, Weekend Whipper: Your Screams Won’t Save You
programme.desc: In this Weekend Whipper Allen Warner, Climber, falls on Course and Buggy (5.11a/b) in Joshua Tree, CA.

programme.title: What's in Brette Harrington's Gear Closet?
programme.desc: Pro climber Brette Harrington shows us her impressive climbing gear "closet", which is multiple parts of her house.

programme.title: Alain Robert Checks in From Bali the Day Before His Birthday
programme.desc: Renowned French climber and free soloist, Alain Robert, reflects on his career in an interview the day before his 63rd birthday. He is known for his daring feats, including free soloing many skyscrapers, and he says has no plans to stop climbing in his 60s.

programme.title: Players for the Planet
programme.desc: Sasha travels to the unlikely climbing destination of the Dominican Republic. On the surface, it's a tropical island paradise with blue water and sandy beaches. But taking a closer look, we see the devastating amounts of pollution on the beaches. So Sasha teams up with Players for the Planet, a group of professional athletes, for a massive clean-up of one of the most polluted beaches in the world.

programme.title: Yoga for Climbers: Yoga for an Active Rest Day CLIMB 26 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Whether you're a veteran big waller, casual gym climber, or putting on sticky rubber for the first time, doing yoga will help you send. In this episode, pro climber and yoga instructor Heidi Wirtz takes you through an active rest day flow.

programme.title: Mary Eden Sends 'Century Crack' (5.14b)
programme.desc: Mary Eden, Pro Climber and Instructor, discusses her recent send of Century Crack in Canyonlands National park, a 5.14B, considered the world’s hardest natural offwidth. She become the first woman to do so, finding her own Beta, as the previous ascensions were all taller men.

programme.title: 2023 National Team Trials: Men's Boulder and Lead Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The 2023 USA Climbing National Team Trials presented by YETI is at the new Mesa Rim climbing facility in Austin, TX. For Team Trials, athletes compete in all three climbing disciplines Bouldering, Lead, and speed. The 2023 U.S. National Team will comprise the top five ranked U.S. athletes per gender in each discipline, including a Boulder & Lead Team. In 2023, athletes from the newly formed Boulder & Lead Team and Speed Team will begin their quest to earn a spot for Team USA at the Paris 2024 Olympics.

programme.title: 2024 YETI National Championships: Men's & Women's Lead Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The 2024 YETI National Championships will be held at the USA Climbing National Training Center in Salt Lake City, UT. Join us to cheer for Team USA and the world’s best competition climbers as IFSC World Cups return to Salt Lake City. The Boulder and Speed World Cup returns May 3-5, while the Paraclimbing World Cup returns May 7-8.

programme.title: Oliver Tippett Narrowly Avoids 60-Foot Fall

programme.title: Head Stuck in a Crack? Stay Calm
programme.desc: News UGC video of professional climber Mary Eden getting her head stuck in a crack in 'Flavor Blasted', a 5.13- sandstone roof crack in Moab, Utah. She eventually frees herself, owing all credit to staying calm, as her friends and climbing partners sigh in relief.

programme.title: Sport Climbing & Hosting a Retreat in Kalymnos, Greece

programme.title: Emily Harrington Talks New Feature Film, 'Girl Climber'

She talks about being one of the first women who become a prominent free climber in Yosemite, and the judgment she received accordingly.

programme.title: Climbing Words, Explained
programme.desc: Evan Wisheropp, Pro Climber, defines common climbing words. Send, means to to get to the top of a wall without falling or hanging on any safety gear. Onsight means to send a route on the first try, with no falls. Other terms like flash and trash refer to ways a climber might send a route. He also defines headpoint, meaning to scope a route on top route, greenpoint, brownpoint, and pinkpoint. On location explainer with original b-roll and graphics.

programme.title: Farm to Table

programme.title: How to Test the Fit of Climbing Shoes

He evaluates the fit of four pairs of shoes, giving pointers: Scarpa Instinct Lace (lace-up), Red Chili Voltage 2 (double velcro closure), Evolv Defy Velcro (single velcro closure), and Scarpa Instinct LE Slipper (no closure).

programme.title: 2024 YETI National Championships: Men's & Women's Lead Semi-Finals | USA Climbing

This prestigious event will showcase the top climbers in the country as they compete in three disciplines: Boulder, Lead, and Speed. The two highest-ranked U.S. athletes will earn a coveted spot on the U.S. National Team for 2024, allowing them to compete on the IFSC World Cup circuit. Some may even have the chance to compete in the Olympic Qualifying Series, where they will vie for additional spots on Team USA.

programme.title: How to Tape Your Hands for Crack Climbing
programme.desc: Crack Camp Climbing Guide Sam Foreman provides tips for how to tape your hands, optimized for crack climbing, in Indian Creek. He demonstrates steps like stretching skin before applying tape, wrapping tape two to three times around the palm, and taping past the wrists.

programme.title: Thunder Muscle

programme.title: Carabiners 101
programme.desc: Genevive Walker, professional climber and Climbing contributor, talks us through the basics of carabiners, showing off different types and explaining their features, purposes, and uses. She covers d-shaped carabiners, oval carabiners, and HMS carabiners; locking carabiners including screwgate lockers, autolockers, and magnetic lockers; and gate types (straight gates and bent gates). A climber must understand how to use their gear properly.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Winter People (1972)
programme.desc: Join Warren Miller for one of his most classic ski films to date. Meet the cast of skiers like Scott Brooksbank, Phil Davis, Lane Monroe, Hal O’Leary, John Truden, Skeeter Zoberski and many more as they ski around the world and show you why they are true Winter People. Journey to places like Chamonix, Bear Valley, Mammoth, Le Meuire, Sugarloaf, and tons of other great places to ski and see first hand where the great sport of skiing originated.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Winter Starts Now (2021)
programme.desc: The 72nd annual ski and snowboard film from Warren Miller Entertainment will chase winter from coast to coast with friends old and new in the places that keep our spirits high no matter what life throws at us. From Alaska’s Prince William Sound, where the only first tracks you’ll encounter belong to bears, to Maine’s community of craftsmen and women devoted to sliding on snow. We’re sharing the dreams of Olympic ambitions and the resolve of adaptive athletes. Follow big mountain skiers Marcus Caston and Connery Lundin on a road trip of a lifetime up to Alaska. Catch up with speed riding legend JT Holmes and meet new friends like Madison Ostergren and Vasu Sojitra. Get stoked because winter starts now. Level up your winter with Warren Miller when you join Outside+.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Wintervention (2010)
programme.desc: Narrated by skiing icon Jonny Moseley, Warren Miller Entertainment’s 61st film – Warren Miller’s Wintervention – features acute cases of classic snow-diction from across the globe. There are the skiers who sail from Argentina to Antarctica searching for some of the last untouched descents on Earth. There are the skiers and riders who venture deep into the Caucasus Mountains of Georgia, chasing rumors they overheard in a language they don't speak and there are the skiers who tour far into the northern reaches of the Arctic Circle where they won't just climb peaks, they'll get their powder fix at the top of the planet. Featuring everything from terrain parks and lift-accessed fresh to the most exotic settings imaginable, Wintervention is the definitive solution for the snow-obsessed. Wintervention highlights the most trusted names in ripping – boards-certified riders like Chris Davenport, JJ Thomas, Lindsey Vonn and Hugo Harrison – and top young talent in the field – innovators like Andy Mahre, Jossi Wells and Zach Black.

programme.title: Earn Your Turns
programme.desc: Ski mountaineers earn their turns from the backcountry of Montana and the remote wilderness of the Chugach Mountains in Alaska to the famed Haute Route in Chamonix, France.

programme.title: Lost in Translation
programme.desc: Greece, Nepal and Kazakhstan provide the backdrops for winter adventure and, of course, s not a real adventure until something goes wrong.

programme.title: Warren Miller's 75 (2024)
programme.desc: Warren Miller is going big for 75 years! Stacked with unbelievable action and unexpected stories, Warren Miller’s 75 will bring fans to powder stashes and chutes around the world, from Canada, Colorado, California, and Utah to Finland, Japan, Austria, and New Jersey. Catch a diverse lineup of snowsports legends, Olympic hopefuls, world champions, X Games stars, and emerging talents, including snowboarders Shaun White, Jeremy Jones, Danny Davis, and Toby Miller, plus skiers Max Hitzig, Lexi duPont, Caite Zeliff, Mark Abma, and Aaron Blunck. With original segments and unique collaborations, this year’s film sets the tone for the next 75 years of ski and snowboard filmmaking. Get ready for the celebration that is 75.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Storm (2002)
programme.desc: You can’t have all the things we love like skiing and snow without a good Storm. Follow along as skiers and riders like Seth Morrison, Toby Dawson, Jeremy Bloom, Tanner Hall, and Glen Plake tackle every condition and obstacle in their way head on in order to ski some of the freshest snow around. Warren Miller takes you on a trip from Idaho, California, and Colorado, all the way to Canada, Austria and even to the distant country of Georgia and along the way proves that a good Storm can happen wherever you’re at.

programme.title: Warren Miller's SNO-CIETY (2025)
programme.desc: Warren Miller’s SNO-CIETY is a celebration of the spirit of winter—wherever you ride, and however you connect to the snow and the community around it. From big mountain lines and race gates to urban ski hills and unexpected destinations, come along as we carve turns and find our crew—from California, Colorado, and New Hampshire to Austria, British Columbia, Finland, and Scotland. Drop in with Olympians, urban riders, and local legends on the big screen this fall, including Daron Rahlves, Britta Winans, Judd Henkes, Sarka Panacochova, Breezy Johnson, Chris Rubens, Juho Kilkki, and more.

programme.title: Off the Beaten Path
programme.desc: Jonny Mosely looks at the lesser known places for powder where time seems to stand still.

programme.title: Have Skis Will Travel
programme.desc: Jonny Moseley a look at skiing in such diverse locations as Kashmir, India and the Canyons in Utah.

programme.title: Tien Shan Dream
programme.desc: A team of international skiers embarks on a two-week glacier traverse connecting two remote research stations in Kazakhstan. The Tien Shan's 4000+ meter peaks host an active scientific community, leveraging the rare environmental conditions for groundbreaking research. Established during the Soviet Union's occupation, the high-altitude research stations here are home to some of the longest-standing glacier and cosmic radiation experiments in the world - and are surrounded by deadly alpine terrain.

programme.title: Escape (ESC)
programme.desc: Escape is the second movie coming out of the Colorado based FlowStateCrew. The movie has evolved from showing off what it takes to get out and do what they do, to actually a true Core snowboard movie showcasing some of Colorado’s finest snowboarders stepping away from everyday life to head into the backcountry and ride the way they love most. The film brings together pros like Seth Hill and Chris Corning, rising talents such as Hayden Tyler, and dedicated locals including Corbin Hladick, Nicki Weiss, and Ty Dewitt. Rather than chasing the industry spotlight or relying on snowboarding’s biggest names, Escape turns its focus to the riders who are putting in the time and effort simply because they love it. That shift makes the film more relatable while also proving there’s a whole world of snowboarders outside the contest scene who can ride big lines, go huge off jumps, and still bring the fun that makes a snowboard movie worth watching. Escape was filmed over the course of 40 days, 100% in Colorado. While much of the Core snowboard scene has moved to Utah and Washington, there is still a very active scene in CO and the FlowStateCrew is working hard to bring it together and showcase as many great riders and locations possible. This grit before fame, and get it done mentality has produced some amazing content and were excited to show it off.

programme.title: Winter Kickoff

programme.title: Canadian Backcountry
programme.desc: In British Columbia, Sean Pettit and Mark McMorris ditch their snowmobiles and find backcountry lines via helicopter. Later, a disagreement turns into a truck race between Sean and brother, Callum.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Any Snow Any Mountain (1971)
programme.desc: All you need are a pair of skis, snow, and a mountain to journey along in Warren Miller’s Any Snow Any Mountain. With an all star cast of skiers including Jim McConkey, Pepi Stiegler, Jon Reveal, Pat Bauman, Roger Staub and many others, Warren Miller takes you on a ski adventure of a lifetime. Follow along as Warren takes you to some of the best powder filled mountains on the planet. From Squaw Valley, up to Whistler B.C., over to Steamboat, and all the way to Japan, see what the original mono-ski looked like, watch as two people try to go down the mountain on the same skis, and witness for yourself the birth of airborn skiing. Warren Miller’s Any Snow Any Mountain will prove to you that you don’t need much to get out there and ski.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Snowriders 2 (1997)
programme.desc: Snowriders 2 shows that there's definitely more than one way to get down a mountain. Whether its outpacing an oncoming avalanche, kayaking through the snow at 50 miles per hour, windsurfing on fresh powder in Alaska or heli-skiing with disabled skiers, "Snowriders 2" explodes with excitement as world-class snowriders take to the slopes. Snowriders 2 picks up where last year's "Snowriders" left off, bringing audiences more of the world's top skiers and snowboarders, jaw-dropping action and adventure in exotic locations. And, of course, Warren Miller's dry wit and hauntingly familiar voice. The result: an experience that feels more like a thrill ride than a movie.

programme.title: Ed Bassmaster Show
programme.desc: In this installment, hidden-camera comedian Ed Bassmaster works public gatherings, fairs, and crowded happenings. He sends in his cast of oddball characters — the deadpan Skippy, a rotating crew of weirdos, and off-kilter everymen — to bewilder real people who have no clue it's a bit, sparking awkward silences, baffled reactions, and his signature offbeat humor. Packed with quotable catchphrases and can't-look-away moments, it's the character-driven prank comedy that turned Ed Bassmaster into a viral sensation with millions of fans. programme.title: Sleepaway Camp (Edited Version)
programme.desc: After a terrible boating accident killed her family, shy Angela Baker (Felissa Rose, Return to Sleepaway Camp) went to live with her eccentric Aunt Martha and her cousin Ricky. This summer, Martha decides to send them both to Camp Arawak, a place to enjoy the great outdoors. Shortly after their arrival, a series of bizarre and violent accidents begin to claim the lives of various campers. Has a dark secret returned from the camps past or will an unspeakable horror end the summer season for all?

programme.title: Creeping Death
programme.desc: Halloween was always Tims favorite holidayuntil his mother was diagnosed with brain cancer. Now, all he wants is a quiet night in. That is quickly disrupted when his friends pay him an unwanted visit, after stealing a mysterious sack from the doorstep of a local crazy. This sacrilegious act unleashes the Aos Si, a Celtic spirit that walks the Earth on Halloween. They must band together and survive the night or make the ultimate offeringtheir lives--this Halloween, all who trick are treats.

programme.title: House on Haunted Hill
programme.desc: A millionaire offers ten thousand dollars to five people if they agree to stay overnight in a large, spooky, rented house. When you consider that the millionaire is Vincent Price, and the film is directed by Schlock master William Castle, you can bet the five guests are in for a long, bumpy night. This super shocker of the century was a smash hit upon its 1959 release. For architecture buffs, the home used for the exteriors of the haunted house was actually designed by Frank Lloyd Wright and built in 1924!

programme.title: Night of the Living Dead (In Color & Restored) (Edited Version)
programme.desc: This is one of the true cult classics and one of the scariest movies of all time. The dead are walking and hunger for human flesh. A group of panicked survivors are barricaded in a deserted farmhouse while the army of flesh eating zombies hovers outside their door. This over-the-top disk includes a restored original black and white version, and a color version that will thrill the horror film fan and horrify the film purist. We've added a 5.1 surround sound mix, and bonus features including a hilarious audio commentary by Mike Nelson of Mystery Science Theater 3000.

programme.title: The Stendhal Syndrome
programme.desc: When beautiful police detective Anna Manni follows the bloody trail of a sophisticated serial murderer/rapist through the streets of Italy, the young woman falls victim to the bizarre Stendhal Syndrome - a hallucinatory phenomenon which causes her to lose her mind and memory in the presence of powerful works of art.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: After an Arkansas State Trooper is shot and killed, officers catch the murderer and alert the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives when they find weapons and explosives in the man's vehicle. Testing of the weapons leads them to a racist, anti-Semitic paramilitary group. Agents surround the group's compound but the members resist for several days in a nail-biting standoff.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1992, a Washington, DC professor was shot and killed as she tried to get into her car, the latest incident in a series of violent carjackings. One week later, a man robbed a bank and security cameras captured the same vehicle as the getaway car.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.sub-title: FBI Files: The Atlanta Prison Riot
programme.desc: In 1987, Cuban prisoners at the Atlanta Federal Prison broke out homemade weapons and stole handcuffs and radios from prison staff. Soon, the inmates controlled most of the central buildings, taking more than 100 hostages. The FBI was forced to negotiate with hostile prisoners to end the standoff.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.sub-title: FBI Files: No Place to Hide
programme.desc: In the spring of 1997, a killer preyed on senior citizens in the quiet town of River Parish, Louisiana. Victims were robbed, beaten, shot and left for dead. FBI agents soon connected the violent crimes to an area mechanic with a gambling problem.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1996, a series of bank robberies in Texas baffled authorities. But when similar thefts occurred the next year in California, FBI agents linked the crimes and established a modus operandi. Another year later, the robbers took hostages during a violent heist in Las Vegas and the FBI was tasked with stopping these criminals once and for all.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In a suburb of Las Vegas, two robbers brandishing assault rifles ambushed an armored car, killing both guards and seizing thousands of dollars. Authorities were able to link the crime to a series of armed robberies on gambling houses, including the MGM Grand Hotel and Casino. Their main suspect was a recently paroled man with a history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1997, two men used a sledgehammer to break into a Camden, New Jersey home. Police tracked the suspects to a nearby park but the criminals were able to escape after a nearly fatal shootout. One year after the original crime, the FBI was called in when new clues emerged regarding the location of the suspects.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: This special episode examines previous cases to learn about the investigative techniques and innovations used by the FBI.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970s, a Croatian terrorist group linked to the National Resistance party committed acts against non-supportive Croatians living in the United States. With the help of an informant, the FBI apprehended, arrested and convicted members of the group of crimes ranging from conspiracy and extortion to murder.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1994, a rash of home invasions plagued the Detroit area. Each time, masked men disguised as police officers broke in with assault rifles and stole money and jewelry. But when one homeowner shot back, the identity of the intruders was revealed.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In June 1985, a Lebanese terrorist and his four accomplices hijacked Royal Jordanian Flight 405 shortly before take off in Beirut. Several American citizens were on board. The FBI opened a criminal investigation and worked with various other government agencies to form Operation Goldenrod, a task force charged with bringing the terrorist mastermind to justice.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: An escapee from Castro's Cuba was the mastermind behind a secret terrorist organization called Omega 7. This group sought to carry out their mission through bombings and assassinations, financing their crimes through extortion and by assisting drug traffickers.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1990s Philadelphia, a ruthless grab for power led to a full-scale mob war. Using informants and high-tech surveillance, the FBI infiltrated the most powerful mob family in the city and sought to bring down the organization before its own civil war lead to any innocent casualties.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.sub-title: FBI Files: The Great Philly Mob War
programme.desc: In 1990s Philadelphia, a ruthless grab for power led to a full-scale mob war. Using informants and high-tech surveillance, the FBI infiltrated the most powerful mob family in the city and sought to bring down the organization before its own civil war lead to any innocent casualties.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A simple seed pod found at a crime scene provides the missing link in a murder by placing a suspect at the crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Evidence as minute as hairs and fibers can be used to track killers and victims whereabouts.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: How murders can be solved even when the body is missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: The most famous serial killer (Ted Bundy), who may have killed 40 women, was only convicted because of an odontologist's being able to match his teeth with a bite mark on a victim in Florida.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: A simple seed pod found at a crime scene provides the missing link in a murder by placing a suspect at the crime scene.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In 1980, a maid discovered that a copy machine, placed in a busy Las Vegas casino, was actually a bomb. Agents and bomb experts were called in to disarm the deadly device and stop the dangerous extortionist who built it.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A special task force was formed in the early 1990s to combat the flow of Colombia cocaine into New York ports. As part of an elaborate sting operation, one detective went undercover and infiltrated a drug gang connected to Pablo Escobar's Medellin cartel.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: After a parole officer was found shot dead in his car, the FBI, DEA and NYPD struggled to contain the mounting violence from drug gangs that continued to escalate. Authorities sought to put two ruthless drug kingpins, Howard Pappy Mason and Lorezno Fat Cat Nichols, behind bars for the crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980s, the FBI investigated wide-scale corruption among the detectives of the San Juan, Puerto Rico Police Department. Drug trafficking, extortion, kidnapping and murder-for-hire were among the department's known illicit activities. One detective, Victor Sousse, broke the blue wall of silence and went undercover to help the FBI close the lid on the corrupt cops' activities.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When an 80-year-old woman is found barely conscious next to the body of her murdered son in an abandoned van, the FBI was brought in and linked the crime to a teenager and middle-aged man.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When notorious bank robber Byron Chubbuck escaped from New Mexico State Penitentiary in 2000, he almost immediately began stealing again. Though he claimed the stolen loot went to the poor, Chubbuck was no folk hero and the FBI teamed up with U.S. marshals to capture a resourceful criminal who proved he would never stop fighting.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: On July 4, 1987, seven inmates broke out of a high-security prison in New Mexico. The daring escape was orchestrated by convicted murdered William Wayne Gilbert, who was serving a life sentence. In a dangerous manhunt and race against time, authorities and scientists used the Bureau's crime laboratory to catch these dangerous criminals.

programme.title: Code of the Fearless
programme.desc: Fred Scott plays a lawman who goes undercover to expose a dangerous gang of criminals in this action-packed drama. He also has time to sing three songs: Cactus Pete, Gonna Ride, and Heres Romance. Screenwriter Fred Myton would go on to write such offbeat features as Nabonga, and Border Phantom.

programme.title: The Hanged Man
programme.desc: After a condemned gunfighter (Steve Forrest) survives his own hanging, he helps a young widow stop a pitiless land baron from taking her ranch. This television feature boasts a strong cast of recognizable characters, including Will Geer, Sharon Acker, Dean Jagger, BarBara Luna, and Cameron Mitchell. Director Michael Caffey would go on to work on such hit shows as Barnaby Jones and MacGyver. Also, look for John Mitchum, younger brother of Robert, in a small role. This movie originally aired on ABC-TV and was considered the pilot for a possible series. Writer/producer Andrew Fenady was behind several opular TV shows such as Branded and The Rebel, as well as the 1970 John Wayne feature, Chisum.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

programme.title: Custer's Last Stand
programme.desc: The survivor of an Indian attack acquires a rare medicine arrow, and a menacing character named Blade (Reed Howes) will stop at nothing to take it from him. Elmer Clifton (Assassin of Youth, Seven Doors to Death) directs a memorable cast that includes Rex Lease (The Sign of the Wolf, The Monster Walks), Lona Andre (Slaves in Bondage, Death in the Air), and William Farnum (Samson and Delilah). Meanwhile, Frank McGlynn Jr is in the title role of General George A. Custer.

programme.title: Randy Rides Alone
programme.desc: John Wayne was 27 when he starred in this vintage western drama from Hollywoods Poverty Row. He plays Randy Bowers, a man wrongly jailed for murders. With help from a female friend, he breaks out of prison and sets out to find the real killers. Harry L. Fraser (The Last of the Clintons, Rustlers Paradise) directs a strong cast of familiar faces, including legendary sidekick George Gabby Hayes, Earl Dwyer, and one of the hardest ridin stuntmen turned actors, Yakima Canutt.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: John Wayne plays a man wrongly convicted of murder in this exciting western drama from Lone Star Pictures. You'll enjoy plenty of gun action and thundering hoofbeats as he escapes from jail and then joins a gang, hoping to find the real killer! Director Armand Schaefer (The Miracle Rider, The Lost Jungle) whips up some fine performances from a cast of B-movie favorites, including Lane Chandler (Samson and Delilah) and the great stunt rider, Yakima Canutt. And of course, the film features plenty of fight scenes, made memorable by John Wayne's big swinging' right fist! For film buffs: This was one of 11 films Wayne starred in that year, making 1933 one of the busiest years of Wayne's legendary career.

programme.title: Hell Town
programme.desc: In Hell Town (aka Born to the West) John Wayne is back in the saddle as two-fisted Dare Rudd, a roaming cowhand trying to prove he can win a woman's love and outwit a crooked saloon owner. This exciting B-movie from Paramount Pictures was based on a novel by western writer Zane Grey. With a wild and wooly cast that includes Johnny Mack Brown, Marsha Hunt, Monte Blue, and Lucian Littlefield, director Charles Barton (Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein) gives us a tale of romance, action, and high stakes gambling!

programme.title: Daughter of the West
programme.desc: A FLAMING PAGE FROM AMERICAN HISTORY Becomes a powerful motion picture...set against the panoramic grandeur of the West!. Martha Vickers stars as Lolita Moreno, a convent raised woman in the 1880s who learns about her Native American heritage through her relationship with an educated Navajo. Morena had been raised at a California mission, but when she leaves to teach school in Arizona, the threads of her mysterious past are revealed. This leads to her involvement with some dangerous people, and a chance to find love in the most unexpected way. The cast includes Phillip Reed, Donald Woods, William Farnum and Milton Kibbee. Pedro de Cordobaa stars as Chief Wykomas.

programme.title: Last of the Clintons
programme.desc: Icon of early talking pictures, Harry Carey (Red River), portrays the rugged Trigger Carson, a noble cowboy who infiltrates an outlaw gang in order to expose their rackets. Ordered to kidnap a young girl, his identity is revealed and he is forced to fight his way out of the gang and back to safety. Already 56 by the time he signed on to do this and a series of Westerns for Berke Productions, the stately Carrey (who netted an Oscar nomination four years later) was widely lauded at the time for adding a great deal of maturity and respectability due to his undeniable presence and strong performances.

programme.title: Land of Hunted Men
programme.desc: A band of outlaws is terrorizing a town in the West. Leave it to Ray Crash Corrigan and his Range Busters to ride in and save the day. This film marked the return of Corrigan to the famous series; he had appeared in the first sixteen movies but left for a brief hiatus following 1942's ARIZONA STAGECOACH. This was the 21st of 24 movies in the Range Busters series. Produced between 1940-1943, the Range Busters were a huge financial success for Monogram Pictures.

programme.title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
programme.desc: The Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, killing all but one. The surviving ranger is nursed back to health by Native American Tonto, and takes on the identity of a masked vigilante, determined to bring all outlaws to justice. Culled from episodes of the popular TV series, this feature is great fun for fans of the Lone Ranger. Starring Clayton Moore and Jay Silverheels.

programme.title: The Red Rope
programme.desc: Hired killers and Old West outlaws stand front and center in this riveting tale from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Bob Steele, one of the busiest stars in movie history (everything from the silent era to Republic Pictures to working with Clint Eastwood in Hang Em High) is here as Tom Shaw, the target of a bad mans desperation and hate. Steele appeared in more than 240 movies and television shows, but was never more impressive than in The Red Rope!

programme.title: Brothers of the West
programme.desc: Tom Tyler plays Tom Wade, a range detective whose brother has been accused of robbery and murder. Wade has only one clue to prove his brothers innocence: a set of unusual tire tracks. This film was directed by Sam Katzman, who later became known as Jungle Sam for his association with a variety of jungle thrillers, and then as a master of all exploitation genres, from teen horror to flying saucer flicks!

programme.title: A Lust to Kill
programme.desc: An imprisoned outlaw escapes and goes on the hunt for his brothers murderers, who just happen to be members of the outlaws own gang. He and his beloved hit the trail, but are pursued by local law enforcement, who have their own plans for justice. Starring Don Megowan, Jim Davis, and Allison Hayes.

programme.title: Law of the Pampas
programme.desc: Murder below the Equator...and Hopalong Cassidy races to action in the heart of the wild Pampas country !Hoppy (William Boyd) and his pal Lucky (Russell Hayden) head to South America to look after a herd of cattle sold by Cassidy's boss to an Argentine rancher. Unfortunately, the scoundrel Ralph Merritt (Sidney Blackmer) wants the cattle, and he's not above hiring some dangerous characters to do his dirty work. It's a test of blazing guns...under a blazing sun! Can the boys of Bar 20 lay down the law in a lawless place like the Pampas? Can Hoppy and his gang succeed in what is truly a last frontier? Watch and see!

programme.title: Billy The Kid Returns
programme.desc: Who would ever mistake Roy Rogers for Billy the Kid? That's exactly what happens in this actionpacked horse opera from Republic Pictures. Rogers arrives on the scene shortly after Pat Garrett (Wade Boteler) kills the infamous Billy the Kid (also played by Rogers). Though Billy was a killer, he was on the side of the homesteaders against a coterie of big time ranchers. As Billy's death is unknown to the public, Roy gets Garrett to let him pose as Billy to continue the fight against the ranchers, but without the bloodshed. We also get six songs, including When the Sun is Setting on the Prairie...

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures feature about the hunt for silver in a deserted ghost town. Songs include 'Colorado Joe' and 'Everything's Going My Way'. Plus, look for Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher. Film buffs should look for silent screen foil James Finlayson, a familiar face from various Keystone Cop comedies, as the local sheriff.

programme.title: Bad Man of Deadwood
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Gabby Hayes are together again in this Republic Pictures gem. This time theyre trying to set up a medicine show in Deadwood, a town known for dangerous entrepreneurs who dont like competition. Sally Payne is on-hand as a member of the troop where Roy and Gabby work as entertainers, while Carol Adams plays a reporter who may have a romantic interest in Roy. Songs include Song of the Dusty Trail, and Home on the Rangeland.

programme.title: Bells of San Angelo
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Dale Evans team up in this tale of silver mines, kidnappings, and secret passages. Roy plays a border guard who has to rescue Dale from the clutches of underhanded miner Rex Gridley (John McGuire). How does he do it? With help from Trigger, of course! With a cast that inclues Andy Devine as Sheriff Cookie Bullfincer, director William Witney gives us an enjoyable drama from the golden era of Republic Pictures!

programme.title: Wildfire: The Story of a Horse
programme.desc: Fanning (John Miljan) has his men rustle horses and then blame it on a wild horse named Wildfire. Happy and Alkali arrive and immediately get into trouble with Fanning and his men. When Alkali is shot, Happy catches the outlaws but the Judge not only releases them, he discharges the Sheriff and tries to arrest Happy for rustling! Starring Bob Steele and Sterling Holloway, directed by Robert Emmett Tansey. 1945 (Color).
