programme.title: Gordon's Great Escape
programme.desc: In tonights final programme Gordon heads south to the coasts of Kerala for the ultimate seafood curry. In Tamil Naduhe hits a meat-free zone and faces his biggest culinarynightmare, living in an ashram where the only food on the menu is vegetarian. Any tranquillity soon evaporates when Gordon tries his highest-octane sport yet - bullock racing - before his final stop in the slums of Mumbai. There he cooks on Slumdog Millionaire streets before putting himself to the ultimate test, cooking alongside one of India's top chefs for a star-studded dinner at the Taj Hotel.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Shark Bait
programme.desc: The shark is one of the most extraordinary creatures on earth terrifying, beautiful and, for many, delicious. Fascinated by both how it is caught, and how it is consumed, Gordon explores the shark fishing industry, the history and culture behind shark fin soup, as well as the increasing demand for shark meat. But with shark numbers in decline he asks whether shark is a dish that needs to come off our menus for good.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Gordon visits Mayfair, a restaurant with a prime location on the busy seafront in Fuengirola, Costa del Sol. With thousands of hungry sun seekers right on its doorstep, the restaurant should be raking it in but the place is totally empty. Gordon discovers multiple fridges and freezers filled with tat and a kitchen brimming with microwaves. Gordon struggles with a venue and staff that plumb new depths of despair.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Gordon visits struggling Le Deck restaurant in South West France. Despite every effort, the restaurant is running at a loss of fifty thousand a year. While the neighbouring French restaurants are thriving, Le Deck boasts more staff than customers. Massive overheads and chaotic leadership mean owners Tim and Debbie are watching Le Deck head for the rocks. Debbie begs Tim to walk away from the restaurant but he stubbornly refuses.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: In a series first, Gordon is tackling a brand new up-market start up restaurant, La Granada Divino, its only been open for 8 weeks but is already heading for disaster. Owners Milan and Gina have never run a restaurant and have sunk their savings and retirement fund in to the place.Gordon is told the ex-head chef of celebrated London restaurants Scotts and Fifth Floor Harvey Nichols is in the kitchen, so is shocked by the confused and dated menu, until he carries out some background checks.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits a Caribbean style resort hotel in Fort Pierce, Florida where the young inexperienced owner, Brian is making guests time at the hotel miserable with filthy rooms, late night concerts and shocking service. Brian has lost control, leaving the hotel staff to run wild. Gordon quickly realizes hes going to need something short of a miracle if hes going to stop this place from going under water.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Island Park, Idaho to try and rescue the failing Anglers Lodge. Despite building the stunning lodge with his own hands, owner Dave Ebey has lost his passion and it has almost cost him his business. Gordon discovers a family tragedy has devastated the Ebeys and caused them to shy away from the hotel and the community. Gordon is desperate to help this couple at their breaking point but is he too late?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Harpers Ferry in West Virginia, to try to save a historic hotel thats desperately in need of help. Karan Townsend, the owner, runs the hotel like a thrift store and hoards junk everywhere. Under Karans management the business and the hotel have started to fall apart. Gordon gets the shock of his life as he witnesses the worst dinner service he has ever had the misfortune to see. This disaster of a hotel could be too much for even Gordon Ramsay to save.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon continues his mission to fix the failing Towns Inn in Harpers Ferry, West Virginia despite having to shut down the hotel after witnessing some shocking food practices. These are some of the worst Ramsay has encountered; some so serious they threaten the lives of the guests, as well as the life of the hotel. Gordon is left in even more disbelief as he uncovers some even more terrifying cleanliness issues.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: The Vienna owners Jonathan and Lisa Krach are at their breaking point and have become trapped in their Austrian themed hotel, drowning in debt. Gordon discovers some shocking rumors about the owners and the real reason customers have stopped coming to the European inspired Inn. Can Gordon keep the doors to this historic hotel open, or is he too late?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Cambridge, New York, where ex-military man John Imhof and his wife, Tina, own and run the allegedly haunted Cambridge Hotel. General John runs the hotel like a dictatorship, an approach thats driving the staff crazy and the guests straight out the door. Gordons stay at the hotel is genuinely terrifying, but its not the ghost that keeps him awake, its something far worse.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits The Keating, a luxury boutique hotel in San Diego, CA. The Keatings supercar-obsessed owner, Eddie Kaen, has blown millions designing the hotel to look like an Italian sports car, but neglected to spend money on things the guests really need. The rooms are empty, the hotels restaurant is failing and the staff have reached their limit, leading to a truly shocking crisis that no one saw coming.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to The River Rock Inn in Milford Pennsylvania, where owner Ken Pisciotta is over his head and drowning in debt. Unable to get any guests to stay in his neglected inn, Ken has all but given up, and his constant negativity is making the entire staff question whether lifes too short to continue working there. Can Gordon get the River Rock back on track before Ken loses everything?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to the Juniper Hill Inn in Windsor, VT, a place that looks like a million dollars but smells of raw sewage. He meets the inns wealthy and arrogant owner, Robert Dean II, and uncovers his shocking treatment of his staff. Gordon quickly realizes its going to need something approaching a miracle if hes going to have a chance of saving this place.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Its Gordons greatest challenge to date, as he continues to uncover problem after problem at Vermonts Juniper Hill Inn. He tries to help the staff against arrogant owners Robert and Ari, but after catching one of them in a shocking lie, Gordon feels he has no choice but to do something hes never done before. Abandon ship.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Coeur DAlene, Idaho, to try to rescue the failing Roosevelt Inn. Despite being over a million dollars in debt, the Roosevelt's owner, John Hough, is more interested in telling jokes and dressing up as Sherlock Holmes than he is in fixing his struggling B&B. To make matters worse, John's wife Tina is ready to run away from the inn and from her buffoon of a husband. Can Gordon get through to John before he destroys both his business and his marriage?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits Meson de Mesilla, a luxury Tuscan-style hotel in Las Cruces, New Mexico. Owner and child-star, Cali Szczawinski, purchased the hotel to perform Cher songs every night to a captive audience. Too busy trying to hit the high notes on stage (the hotel has three of them), Cali has failed to notice that shes falling flat when it comes to what her hotel guests need. The bedrooms are empty, the hotels restaurant is failing, and Gordon witnesses a shocking exit that no one saw coming. Can Gordon turn back time? Or is this boutique hotel, and its singing owner, beyond his help?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to The Monticello Hotel in Longview, Washington, owned by Phillip Lovingfoss: a wealthy individual with a fleet of classic cars, an array of diamond rings and a drinking problem so serious that it is threatening to destroy his hotel, and his life. Gordon discovers the extent of Phillips problem when he sees shocking news about the owner splashed all over the front page of the newspaper. Can Gordon save fifty staff jobs and keep the doors to this ninety year old hotel (a place once described as the jewel of Longview) open, or is he too late?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Applegate, Oregon, to try to rescue the failing Applegate River Lodge. Despite being over a million dollars in debt, the Applegates owner, Richard Davis, is more interested in smoking cannabis in his Butt Hut than he is in fixing the problems of this family-built inn. Richards sons Duke and Dusty are too busy fighting each other to notice the ever-increasing debt, leaving their mother, Joanna with the entire burden of the inns finances resting on her shoulders. Can Gordon turn this family around before the hotel and the family legacy are destroyed? And how will he react to a room full of dancing mushrooms and a dog that swims through the air?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Starkville, Mississippi to try to rescue the failing Hotel Chester. Despite having over 40 years experience in the hotel business, owner David Mollendor is at a loss on how to make his dream of owning his own hotel work. Sukie, his wife, is struggling as the hotel restaurants chef, tackling the role without any culinary experience, and sinking fast. Gordon discovers a family tragedy which explains why this couple have become trapped in their hotel and are drowning in debt. Gordon is desperate to help the two owners escape from their suffering, but is he too late to stop the hotels doors closing for good?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits West Dover in Vermont, to try to save a dog-friendly hotel thats desperately in need of help. Sandy MacDougall, the owner, runs the hotel like a hostel with unpaid staff staying in the rooms instead of paying guests. Can Gordon get the Four Seasons back on track before Sandy loses everything? Or is the kindest thing simply to put this dog-friendly hotel to sleep?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to Murphys Historic Hotel near Sacramento in northern California, where party-boy owners Brian, Kevin and Joel are too busy drinking, partying and lap-dancing in the rowdy bar, to look after their historic hotel. The national landmark, which has been host to an array of famous names including Mark Twain, President Ulysses S. Grant and J.P. Morgan, has no hotel manager, so guests have a miserable time in the noisy, neglected, afterthought of a hotel. Gordon quickly realizes hes going to need something approaching a miracle if hes going to have a chance of saving this chaotic place.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon checks in to Connecticuts oldest inn, the Curtis House. This historic inn has been run by the Hardisty family for generations, but the business has started to fall apart and the family legacy is on the brink of being lost. The inn is currently run by brother and sister, T.J and Chris, but they no longer speak to each other and the staff and guests are stuck in the middle. Can Gordon save the historic inn and rescue a family at breaking point? And what will Gordon make of Betty, the inns resident ghost who he has to share a bedroom with?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to the Historic Calumet Inn, in Pipestone, Minnesota. Joint owners, Vanda and Rina Smrkovski were given the inn as a gift by their father (who they still call daddy), and they treat it with less respect than a dolls house. These spoilt little girls have been playing hotel for nine months, and their idle behavior has left the staff working double time, and on the brink of revolt, and their guests suffering. Gordon quickly realizes that daddys little girls need to grow up, and fast, if hes going to have a chance of saving this place. Will the wheels on the bus keep going round and round, or have they already come off?

programme.title: Stanley on the Go
programme.desc: Stanley Siegel, the late broadcaster, known to millions for his groundbreaking and often controversial interviews on WABC-and with Stanley On The Go he single-handedly redefines the travel show. Indeed, he redefines the notion of adventure: you don't have to be a young Olympian to have a zest for life. Experience shouldn't - and doesn't - end at 60. Stanley shows that there's more to retirement than bingo and shuffleboard on the Lido deck. He's an inspiration. Stanley takes us headlong around the globe: whether he's on a camel in Giza, the deck of a Navy aircraft carrier off San Diego, straddling a speeding motorbike through the streets of Moscow, or balancing on top of the Sydney Harbor Bridge, each episode is a tour de force with a force of nature. Stanley is irrepressible, his commentary is not only informative and enlightening, but is also often surprising and frequently irreverent. He shows us the iconic sights-the Grand Tour-but also uncovers the unexpected.

programme.title: Cardboard Boxer
programme.desc: Willie (Thomas Haden Church) is a goodhearted man living rough on the dangerous streets of Los Angeles’ Skid Row and finds himself coerced by two rich teenagers into fighting other homeless men for cash. Stuck in a violent world he doesn’t fully understand, Willie finds solace when he discovers the discarded diary of a troubled young girl and befriends a homeless veteran, Pinky (Boyd Holbrook). A cab driver named Pope (Terrence Howard) lends Willie a blanket, looks after his friends on the street, and is protective of this little world normally condemned to invisibility. Academy Award nominees Thomas Haden Church and Terrence Howard join GONE GIRL actor Boyd Holbrook in Knate Lee’s (BAD GRANDPA, JACKASS 3D) directorial debut, a powerful tale of loss, redemption, and friendship.

programme.title: American Violet
programme.desc: After an overzealous district attorney's drug bust lands her in jail, single mother Dee Roberts must face an agonizing choice: Plead guilty and go home a convicted felon, or fight the charges and risk a lengthy prison sentence. Despite her mother's advice and risking everything, innocent Dee chooses to fight the criminal justice system, joined by an ACLU attorney and a former narcotics cop.

programme.title: Half of a Yellow Sun
programme.desc: Olanna (Thandie Newton) and Kainene (Anika Noni Rose) are glamorous twins from a wealthy Nigerian family. Upon returning to a privileged city life in newly independent 1960s Nigeria after their expensive English education, the two women make very different choices. Olanna shocks her family by going to live with her lover, the “revolutionary professor” Odenigbo (Chiwetel Ejiofor) and his devoted houseboy Ugwu (John Boyega) in the dusty university town of Nsukka; Kainene turns out to be a fiercely successful businesswoman when she takes over the family interests, and surprises even herself when she falls in love with Richard (Joseph Mawle), an English writer.

programme.title: Exit Strategy
programme.desc: James gets evicted from his apartment and has no choice but to move in with his girlfriend Kim. He quickly discovers that she is not what he wants and needs an exit strategy fast. But for Kim, breaking up just isn't an option.

programme.title: The Argument
programme.desc: A couple get into an argument at their cocktail party that escalates until it brings an abrupt end to the festivities. They and their guests decide to re-create the entire night again and again to determine who was right.

programme.title: Skin In The Game
programme.desc: Abducted off the sidewalk of suburban America, fifteen year old Dani (Sammi Hanratty) finds herself submerged in a horrific human trafficking ring run by Eve (Angélica Celaya). With no initial assistance from the police, Dani's mother (Elisabeth Harnois) and an ex-prostitute (Erica Ash) take to the streets in an effort to find her before it is too late. First time director Adisa takes viewers on an intense journey of a horrific underground world and introduces us to characters from both sides of the street, some who survive … and others who are not so lucky.

UFA 462 - Shamrock FC 369
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 369 from Ameristar Hotel and Casio in Missouri. In this episode Kylen Snider takes on Ryan Richmond and Cedric Vinson faces Blake Alan. Hometown favorite Anthony Dooley "The Stormin' Morman" takes on Nick Maxwell. In the co-main event BJJ blackbelt James Regina steps into the cage with undefeated Mike Boyle looking to keep his win streak alive and in the main event undefeated Tyson Hicks takes on Andrew Horowitz in what could be Hicks' last fight in the cage,

programme.title: UFA 499 - UFA’s Baddest Babes – Best of part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Best of Baddest Babes part 2 with an action-packed episode featuring all female fighters showcasing the skill, strength and personalities of women redefining the world of combat sports. Bouts include SFT: Camila Santos versus Ruth Ravena, Breakthrough MMA: Caitlin Sammons versus Jessica Borga, TuffNUff MMA: Jessica Branco versus Cheyanne Vlismas, SFT: Gisele Moreira versus Daiane Firmino,CFL: Maraya Miller versus Alenita Perez, TuffNUff: Brieta Carpenter versus Serena DeJesus and Ronda Rousey versus Autumn Richardson.

programme.title: UFA 491 - Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 1 from the Sala Sporturilor in Targu Jiu, Romania. This episode features a middleweight kickboxing tournament with Darius Olteam versus Edmond Mustafa, Cezar Buzdugan versus Stefan Vranceanu, Andre Varga versus Cristian Neacșu and Laurenti-Gabi Fatiol versus Albert Enache. The winners of each of these quarter finals will move to the next round in the championship tournament.

programme.title: UFA 493 - Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 31 part 2 from the Sala Sporturilor in Targu Jiu, Romania. Tonight features two heavyweight matchups and the finals of the middleweight tournament. In the first heavyweight bout Petrisor Gananau faces Leonard Ioncila in an Entertainment Boxing Match. Next up is a kickboxing Super Fight in the heavyweight division with Tibor Varga facing undefeated Vasile Corcodel in a Hungary versus Maldova faceoff. In a boxing matchup in the Super Middleweight division, Valentin Cioaca faces Veronel Tarau. The main event is the final of the eight man pyramid tournament to determine the DFS Middleweight Champion.

programme.title: UFA 489 - 8IGHT Strikes: Standup Mixed Martial Arts part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents 8IGHT Strikes Standup MMA part 1 from the Woolwich Works Arena in London with eight strikes scoring. First up is a female matchup in the lightweight division between Karolina Kadzielawa and the more experienced Molly McCulloch. In the next bout with Full Thai Rules, Frank Mulley takes on Shea Patton with an undefeated record. In a welterweight feature fight of the night, "The Boy" Ryan Moore steps into the ring with Saj Imran.

programme.title: UFA 490 - 8IGHT Strikes: Standup Mixed Martial Arts part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents 8IGHT Strikes Standup MMA part 2 from the Woolwich Works Arena in London with eight strikes scoring. Starting off this episode, undefeated Josh Gravesande takes on AJ Durrani in a bantamweight contest. In the next bout, Harry Moore takes on the more experienced Lyes Marinko in the welterweight division. In the main event, Mo Abdurahman takes on lias Krafi for the Featherweight World Title with Full Thai rules and no elbows in this matchup between South Africa and Morocco.

programme.title: UFA 345 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 33 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 33 Part 1 from London. In this episode, Sean McPike faces Ash Williams in a battle between Birmingham and Wales. Nathan Decastro takes on Tony Shields, Luke Smith gets in the ring with Corey Healey, Liam Rees fights Joe Fitzpatrick in a flyweight title clash and Bradley Scott current cruiser weight champion faces the challenger Kevin Greenwood for the title.

programme.title: UFA 346 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 33 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 33 Part 1 from London part 2. Starting off this episode, Ireland's Jonny Lawson battles Brighton's Sonny Smith in the Prize Fighter semi-final bout and Aaron Sinclair and Scott McHugh matchup for the second semi-final bout where the winning fighters will head to Thailand for the final match. Dan Lerwell takes on C.J. Mills in the World Middle Weight Title clash and in the main event Jimmy Sweeney takes on Ionel Levitchi.

programme.title: UFA 378 - Shamrock FC 354
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 354 from Ameristar Casino. Up first is Garren Lucas verus Eric Carrera while Gabe Stein and Joseph Murphy face off. Kody McGehee and Ernest Bolt battle it out for the lightweight title and in the main event Darian Weeks faces Max Choriev in a match between two UFC veterans.

programme.title: UFA 471 - Shamrock FC 370 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 370 part 1 from Ameristar Casino in Missouri. In the first match, Gabe Sestan steps into the cage with Adam Cook followed by Reggie Morris versus Jackson Blankenship. Also on the card Ian Houston takes on Garrenn Lucas in the catchweight division plus Shaine Moffitt versus Kody McGehee in a lightweight bout. In the co-main event, Austin Miller, a kickboxer crosses over to MMA taking on Michael Banks.

programme.title: UFA 475 - Shamrock 370 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 370 part 2 from Ameristar Casino in Missouri. Starting off this episode Noah Stockdale faces Emmanuel "Primetime" Primer in a kickboxing match. Next up Rohan Aibara steps into the cage with Cameren Harris while Jackson Henson takes on Tyreace Wilbourn in an MMA scrap both fighters making thier professional debut. The main event features undefeated prospect and hometown favorite Jacob Highley taking on Eric Beck one of the best wrestlers in the midwest.

programme.title: UFA 473 - Clan Wars 53 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 53 part 1 from Belfast, Ireland. Padraig Irvine steps into the cage with Sean Gallagher and fan favorite Christopher Boyd squares off against Maksym Danchevesky. In a middleweight bout, Lukas Ptacek and Damian Bobek head to the cage and Rogger Lopez takes on Andrew Barrett.

programme.title: UFA 477 - Clan Wars 53 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 53 part 1 from Belfast, Ireland. In the first match, Kyle McLaughlin squares off against Gustavo Borges followed by Achmed Bairov who takes on his opponent Omar Al Haj. Next up in the cage, Tristan Barnett faces Peter Halpenny for the Clan Wars 175 pound title. The main event features another title fight as Nate Kelly takes on Ricardo Dearaujo for the belt in the 125 pound division.

programme.title: UFA 470 - Up Next Fighting 16 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 16 part 1 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. Starting off this episode is Gebril Chaibi versus Miguel Guzman in a flyweight bout followed by a light heavyweight matchup as Blair Sannoh and Emmanueli Adzoh step into the cage. In the main event, Anthony "The Bully" Romero takes on Ricardo Diaz, the Brazillian veteran, for the vacant UNF Bantamweight title.

programme.title: UFA 474 - Up Next Fighting 16 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 16 part 2 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. In ther first bout, Angel Becerra steps into the cage with undefeated Carson Dohan. In the lightweight division, veteran Darion Champman looks to stop Diego Perez' three bout winning streak. Up next grappler Joe Murphy returns to the cage for a match against boxer Luciano Ramos in a catchweight bout.

programme.title: UFA 479 - Up Next Fighting 16 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 16 part 3 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. Young prospect Joseph Rodriguez looks to keep his undefeated record intact against Jesse Langarica making his pro debut in a catchweight bout. In the main event, it's a battle for the UNF featherweight title, as UFC veteran Francisco Rivera takes on UFC hopeful Jesse Strader.

programme.title: UFA 478 - Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 1 from the Sala Sporturilor Constantin Jude in Timisoara, Romania. Starting off in the welterweight division, Ionel Balan takes on Adrian Maxim under superfight K1 rules. In a super middleweight bout, Andei Varga and Bogdan Takacs step into the ring while Valentin Bordianu and Cristian Conea meet up for a heavyweight match. Eduard Gafencu and Florin Lambagiu take to the ring in the co-main event in the light-heavyweight division under superfight MMA rules - boxing with MMA gloves.

programme.title: UFA 480 - Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 2 from the Sala Sporturilor Constantin Jude in Timisoara, Romania. Up first in a kickboxing middleweight bout are Vitalie Matei and Calin Petrisor - the KO Hunter. The main event is a superfight boxing matchup, World Champion Flavius Biea takes on The Hyena Daniel Corbeanu.

programme.title: UFA 500 - SFT Combat 63
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents SFT Combat 63 from Sao Paolo, Brazil. Up first, an Xtreme fight in the heavyweight division between Pedro Orlando and Breno Souza and in the flyweight division, Paulo Andre and Bruno Brito step into the cage. In an Xtreme Karate bout, Caique Korchak faces Luiz Soares plus in an MMA catchweight bout, Joab Baianinho and Vitor Showman faceoff. In an Xtreme female matchup, Maju Bertin and Giovanna Bonanome take to the cage in what's expected to be a striking battle.

programme.title: UFA 484 - Dynamite Fighting Show - Best of part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents The Best of Dynamite Fighting Show part 1 from Romania. In the first bout Damian Johansen from the Netherlands versus Andrei "The Bone Crusher" Varga from Romania face off in the middleweight division. Next up, a Superfight in the Open Division, Spain's Vajtan Shanava faces Romania's Claudiu "The Prince" Badoi. Stepping into the ring next for a boxing match are Gilson DaSilva from Brazil versus Florin Cardos from Romania. Also on this card, two Romanian's battle it out as the younger Sebastian Lutaniuv takes on the more experienced Marius Munteanu with 22 KO's.

programme.title: UFA 485 - Clan Wars 54 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 54 part 1 from Belfast, Ireland. Kevin Walsh steps into the cage with Nate Kelly the defending flyweight champion with the title on the line while Simon Sackey faces Jonny Ward and Aaron Henry takes on Kian McCarton. In the co-main event Mick McBride and Shivraj Patil look to trade punches in the cage.

programme.title: UFA 486 - Clan Wars 54 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 54 part 2 from Belfast, Ireland. First up, in a female bout, Alexa Padugan squares off against Gemma Coghill in a rematch. Followed by Billy Sutherland and Jean Bernard Kamali in another rematch in the Clan Wars cage. Next up in the welterweight division, Kyle Paton faces "Lethal" Shea Leathem and in the main event, Bobby Smith and Chris Boyd take to the cage for what's expexted to be an explosive matchup.

programme.title: UFA 488 - Fighters Only 17th World MMA Awards
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents the Fighters Only 17th Annual World MMA Award Show from Las Vegas hosted by UFC Hall of Famer Chael Sonnen. The fan-voted event covers the sport’s biggest performances and major storylines over the last year featuring star-studded presenters and features the major performance categories such as knockout of the year and fight of the year as well as the lifetime achievement award. Presenters include Maxx Crosby, Neal McDonough, Akbar Gbaja-Biamila, Frank Mir, Bella Mir, Millennium All Stars, Jon Anik, Valentin Chmerkovskiy, K-La Duncan, Nina Drama, Lochlyn Munro, Natalie Lind, Dr. Octagon and Shawne Merriman

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius - Donna lee
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius’s electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Earl Hines - Earl Hines Quartet in Spa, 1977
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can’t Believe That You’re In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.” Marva Josie joins the group for soulful renditions of “A Sunday Kind of Love” and the well-known classic “Kansas City” before the set comes to a close with “Caravan,” which features a lengthy drum solo by Graham.

programme.title: Al Di Meola, Chris Carrington & Arto Tuncboyaciyan - Al di Meola - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1993, American guitarist Al Di Meola was one of the artists appearing here. With second guitarist Chris Carrington and percussionist Arto Tunçboyacıyan, Meola performs the now-classic world-fusion repertoire from his album 'World Sinfonia', which was originally released in 1991.

programme.title: Oscar Peterson - Oscar Peterson - C Jam Blues
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson’s virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964. Let the sublime artistry of Art Tatum captivate you as he interprets Antonín Dvořák's “Humoresque” in 1953. Discover Thelonious Monk’s enigmatic genius as his quartet performs his iconic composition “Round About Midnight” in Poland on April 4, 1966. Experience the timeless appeal of the Dave Brubeck Quartet's odd-metered “Take Five", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium, on October 10, 1964. Delight in the lyrical beauty of Bud Powell's solo performance of “Sweet and Lovely” at the Antibes Jazz Festival of July 13, 1960. Witness the fusion of jazz and funk in Herbie Hancock & The Headhunters' exhilarating studio performance of “Sly” in Bremen, Germany, recorded on November 6, 1974. Lastly, enjoy the soulful grooves of Horace Silver's “Song for my Father” performed by his quintet at the Umbria Jazz Festival of July 20, 1976. Tune in and let these legendary jazz pianists transport you on unforgettable musical adventures!

programme.title: Bootsy Collins - Casper the Funky Ghost: Bootsy Collins à Vienne
programme.desc: Bootsy Collins, famed for playing with George Clinton and his very own Rubber Band, is used to playing syncopated, hard and relentlessly rhythmic music. With this unique style Bootsy was a major influence on the development of funk. Now in his 60s, the bassist seems animated by a new energy that reflects his new work on the album ‘Tha Funk Capitol of the World’. With this album, Bootsy Collins pays tribute to the artists with whom he worked during his frantic career: from James Brown and Parliament-Funkadelic to Fatboy Slim. During this concert, recorded at the festival Jazz à Vienne, Bootsy maintains that same energy, giving a spectacular show.

programme.title: Milt Jackson, John Lewis, Percy Heath & Connie Kay - Milt Jacksons' Modern Jazz Quartet at the Bozar
programme.desc: The Modern Jazz Quartet (MJQ) was composed of Milt 'Bags' Jackson on vibraphone, John Lewis on piano, Percy Heath on bass, and Connie Kay on drums. Milt Jackson and John Lewis were pioneer bebop musicians who had played together in Dizzy Gillespie's 1948 big band. They pursued separate careers before adding Heath and Lewis to form the Modern Jazz Quartet in the 1950s. Noted for its delicate percussion sonorities, innovative jazz forms, and high performance standards, the MJQ was an immensely popular jazz and “third stream” ensemble until its final concerts in the early 1990s.

programme.title: Buck Clayton, Henry Chaix, Théo Siegrist & Pierre Bouru - Buck Clayton - Radio Télévision Suisse 'Variétés'
programme.desc: In the second half of June 1965, during a prolonged European concert tour, American trumpeter Buck Clayton (1911–1991) played a residency at the Chikito, a club in Bern, Switzerland. With a local rhythm section of French pianist Henry Chaix, Swiss double bassist Théo Siegrist, and Swiss drummer Pierre Bouru, this stalwart of the Count Basie Orchestra gave a sparkling performance that was documented for posterity by Radio Télévision Suisse in the program ‘Variétés’. Opening with the George Gershwin favorite ‘’S Wonderful’, the program continues with two swing-era classics: ‘I Can't Get Started’ and ‘Honeysuckle Rose’. Revel at how easily Clayton finishes ‘Honeysuckle Rose’ on a high concert F! A spirited romp through Juan Tizol’s composition ‘Perdido’ closes this recording. The success of this booking ensured Clayton received repeated warm receptions in Bern in the following decades.

programme.title: Miles Davis - Joshua
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell’Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery - Herbie Man & Sonny Sharrock - Memphis underground
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock’s avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Gilberto Gil - Gilberto Gil: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa’: a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo’. This movement, with a strong character of social protest, combines elements of traditional Brazilian culture with modern art forms. Gilberto Gil's new sound clearly has its roots in Brazilian culture, yet it is always inspired by jazz.

programme.title: Paul Desmond - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés - Obatalà
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá’. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés’ piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés’s band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter - Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Together with pianist Jim Beard, guitarist David Gilmore, bassist Alphonso Johnson, and drummer Rodney van Holmes, Shorter shows he is still at his best.

programme.title: John Coltrane - Vigil
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Jamie Cullum - Jazz à Vienne 2017
programme.desc: Watch the performance of Jamie Cullum live at Jazz à Vienne, in 2017.

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas Vella - Sly Johnson & Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday. In 1971, Marvin Gaye released a major record in the history of soul music "What's Going On". Sly Johnson, accompanied by Nicholas Vella's keyboard, makes the hot music of this album groove, a monument of soul and rhythm'n'blues. A true message of love delivered by MarvinGaye, through the story of a Vietnam war veteran who returns home and sees only injustice, suffering and hatred. The abrasive groove of Sly Johnson and Nicholas Vella is a rich music at the crossroads of hip-hop, funk and jazz. Sly Johnson, a great regular of the stage, embarks with extreme generosity the audience in his musical universe, an irresistible performance.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Tigran Hamasyan & Mathias Eick - Tigran Hamasyan & Mathias Eick - November Music
programme.desc: November Music, a Dutch music festival in ’s-Hertogenbosch, showcases today's prominent composers. It programs top-notch ensembles, jazz and world music pioneers, interdisciplinary concerts, and sound art. In 2019, Tigran Hamasyan and Mathias Eick played a duo performance here. Armenian pianist Hamasyan has claimed a category of his own in contemporary jazz. Norwegian trumpeter Mathias Eick is an undisputed master of his instrument.

programme.title: Paul Desmond - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Oscar Peterson Trio, Stuff Smith & Ella Fitzgerald - O.P. Trio and E. Fitz. - Jazz At The Philharmonic
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 5, 1957, jazz impresario Norman Granz presented his Jazz at the Philharmonic tour at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam. The Canadian pianist Oscar Peterson and his trio of guitarist Herb Ellis and bassist Ray Brown are later joined by trumpeter Roy Eldridge and drummer Jo Jones. As an added attraction, American violinist Stuff Smith joins the proceedings. American singer Ella Fitzgerald, accompanied by pianist Don Abney, Ellis, Brown and Jones, hits her vocal peak in a stunning set that culminates in a jam session of It Don't Mean A Thing (If It Ain't Got That Swing) with the entire ensemble.

programme.title: Charlie Galbraith - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Errol Garner - Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer. It features a variety of artists, both visual and aural.

programme.title: Christian McBride - Christian McBride - John Day
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Kenny Barron - Alfa Jazz Festival Lviv, Ukraine
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Buck Clayton, Henry Chaix, Théo Siegrist & Pierre Bouru - Buck Clayton - Radio Télévision Suisse 'Variétés'
programme.desc: In the second half of June 1965, during a prolonged European concert tour, American trumpeter Buck Clayton (1911–1991) played a residency at the Chikito, a club in Bern, Switzerland. With a local rhythm section of French pianist Henry Chaix, Swiss double bassist Théo Siegrist, and Swiss drummer Pierre Bouru, this stalwart of the Count Basie Orchestra gave a sparkling performance that was documented for posterity by Radio Télévision Suisse in the program ‘Variétés’. Opening with the George Gershwin favorite ‘’S Wonderful’, the program continues with two swing-era classics: ‘I Can't Get Started’ and ‘Honeysuckle Rose’. Revel at how easily Clayton finishes ‘Honeysuckle Rose’ on a high concert F! A spirited romp through Juan Tizol’s composition ‘Perdido’ closes this recording. The success of this booking ensured Clayton received repeated warm receptions in Bern in the following decades.

programme.title: Miles Davis - Joshua
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell’Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery - Herbie Man & Sonny Sharrock - Memphis underground
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock’s avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Gilberto Gil - Gilberto Gil: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa’: a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo’. This movement, with a strong character of social protest, combines elements of traditional Brazilian culture with modern art forms. Gilberto Gil's new sound clearly has its roots in Brazilian culture, yet it is always inspired by jazz.

programme.title: Paul Desmond - DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés - Obatalà
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá’. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés’ piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés’s band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter - Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Together with pianist Jim Beard, guitarist David Gilmore, bassist Alphonso Johnson, and drummer Rodney van Holmes, Shorter shows he is still at his best.

programme.title: John Coltrane - Vigil
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career. Recorded in various European cities, Coltrane is seen playing the songs “Autumn Leaves”, “Hackensack”, “My Favorite Things”, “I Want To Talk About You”, “Vigil”, and “Naima”. Tune in and experience why the music of John Coltrane has touched the lives of so many!

programme.title: Jamie Cullum - Jazz à Vienne 2017
programme.desc: Watch the performance of Jamie Cullum live at Jazz à Vienne, in 2017.

programme.title: James Taylor - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: The Moody Blues - Days of Future Passed Live
programme.desc: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of their landmark album, Days of Future Passed, The Moody Blues took to the road to perform the entire LP live. This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance of this seminal album. This spectacle of a show features stunning visuals and a unique narration performed by Jeremy Irons, transporting the audience and viewer to the psychedelic dream world of their classic record. Including the iconic hits Nights In White Satin and Tuesday Afternoon, this film truly pays homage to five decades of musical mastery. In this impressive yet intimate auditorium, The Moody Blues have never sounded better.

programme.title: Paul Simon - Live in New York City
programme.desc: During the first leg of Paul Simon's triumphant, 2011 U.S. tour, he thrilled hometown fans with a special club performance at New York City's historic Webster Hall. The show presents this iconic artist working at the peak of his artistic and creative powers in an unusually intimate setting. The 20-song, 90-minute set list was drawn from his legendary career and includes several songs that haven't been performed live in many years. "Kodachrome," "Mother and Child Reunion," "Gone At Last" and "The Obvious Child" are just some of the highlights as well as songs from Simon's most recent album, 2011's So Beautiful or So What (Hear Music/Concord Music Group) including "Dazzling Blue," "Rewrite," "The Afterlife" and the album's propulsive title track.

programme.title: Tom Petty & The Heartbreakers - Live at Soundstage
programme.desc: Filmed live from the Vic Theatre, Chicago, Illinois, USA in April 2003 for the 'Soundstage' TV series.

programme.title: Willie Nelson - Live at iTunes Festival
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Johnny Cash - Live at Montreux 1994
programme.desc: Johnny Cash was one of the most influential figures in American music in the post war period. He managed to combine elements of folk, rock 'n' roll and country, which together with his distinctive voice and guitar style, created an instantly recognisable sound. 1994 was to prove to be Cash's only appearance at the Montreux Festival. The "Man In Black" had just released his acclaimed American Recordings album and his European tour took in Montreux on July 5. This classic concert features a number of tracks from his new album coupled with favourites from across his career including Folsom Prison Blues, I Walk The Line, Ghost Riders In The Sky, Orange Blossom Special and San Quentin. An added bonus is the guest appearance of his wife June Carter Cash on two tracks. Caught at one of the high points of his distinguished career this is truly Johnny Cash at his best.

programme.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd - Live From The Florida Theater
programme.desc: Earlier this year Lynyrd Skynyrd performed their first two studio albums, “Pronounced ‘Lĕh-’nérd ‘Skin-’nérd” and “Second Helping”, live in their entirety for the first time, at two specially staged concerts at the Florida Theatre in their home town of Jacksonville, Florida. It was a special occasion for both the act and their fans as the band performed tracks they’d never or rarely played live before alongside classic songs that are an essential part of any Lynyrd Skynyrd live show. These unique concerts are a must have for any Lynyrd Skynyrd fan.

programme.title: Def Leppard - Hysteria At The O2
programme.desc: Sheffield’s finest make their long-awaited debut at London’s O2m Arena in November 2018. Marking the 31st anniversary of Hysteria they played the whole of the ground breaking album in chronological order featuring hits like Pour Some Sugar on Me, Animal, Women and the title track. They encored with a selection of other classics including When Love and Hate Collide, Let’s Get Rocked and Photograph. Another career defining moment from the band capture in 4K video and 5.1 audio.

programme.title: The Offspring - Rock AM
programme.desc: The Offspring is an American rock band from Garden Grove, California, formed in 1984. Originally formed under the name Manic Subsidal, the band's lineup consists of lead vocalist and rhythm guitarist Bryan "Dexter" Holland, bassist Todd Morse and lead guitarist Kevin "Noodles" Wasserman.

programme.title: Motörhead - Rock Im Park
programme.desc: Rock im Park is a music festival that takes place in Nuremberg, Germany, lasting three days. Featuring : Motörhead

programme.title: The Killers - Live at Rock Am Ring
programme.desc: Rock Am Ring (Nürburgring), Rock Im Park (Nuremberg) is a music festival that takes place annually at the Nürburgring Race Track in western Germany. Featuring The Killers.

programme.title: Sarah Brightman - Symphony in Vienna
programme.desc: Sarah Brightman is an English soprano singer who has won 160 gold and platinum albums in 34 countries. Only the soundtrack to the musical The Phantom of the Opera, played by Sarah, sold more than 40 million copies.

programme.title: Seal - Live at Soundstage
programme.desc: Seals one-of-a-kind soaring, husky baritone voice is perfect for any genre. Hes delighted fans and earned critical acclaim while staying true to classic, honest songwriting in his remarkable two-decade career. And now, hes done it again with the release of his exceptional sixth studio album Soul. Together with legendary music producer David Foster, Seal adds his signature touch to some of the best soul songs ever created. In a stunning performance, Seal evokes an era when music vividly captured emotion and romance. Joined by Foster, as well as a choir and string section, Seal takes on Ann Pebbles I Cant Stand the Rain, Sam Cookes A Change Is Gonna Come, and Harold Melvin and the Blue Notes If You Dont Know Me By Now. Tune in and catch more timeless favorites and hits like Kiss From a Rose.

programme.title: Jimi Hendrix - American Landing : Live at Monterey
programme.desc: In June 1967, Jimi Hendrix returned to his native country and transformed the cultural, musical and fashion landscapes. Punctuated by Hendrix lighting his instrument on fire, the U.S. debut performance of the Jimi Hendrix Experience at the Monterey Pop Festival propelled the guitarist and his band mates to the top ranks of international rock royalty.

programme.title: James Taylor - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.
